packages.title: Nebula

manifest.title: Nebula
manifest.appDescription: Nebula — add-on browser + player for webOS. An Apple TV-style player (glass controls, thick rounded scrubber, remaining time), a pause board that shows what is playing and what is next, a playback-info HUD, subtitle timing nudges, a picture-quality policy, a live-edge button, a featured hero board, full-bleed title pages with logo art and cast, My List with an upcoming-episode calendar, resume and Continue Watching, next-episode autoplay, a Nebula Profile that carries your add-ons, progress and My List to every device (sign the TV in with a code from your phone — no email), friends by @handle, subtitle appearance controls, and search across every catalogue. Opens full on first run. Plays and decrypts every format.

packages.shortDescription: Add-on browser + player: library, sync, calendar. Add add-ons by phone QR.
